why: Shared by every language pack: how much each signal weighs and where review and slop start. A pack may override any threshold or weight for its language (e.g. zh turns the em-dash rule off: —— is ordinary Chinese punctuation).
scoring: points = the weights of every hit; density = points per 100 words (at least floor_words counted, so a short hero is not let off); review from `review`, slop from `slop`; score = density x 5, capped at 100. One strong hit makes a text at least `review`; a leaked chat voice (kind leak) makes it `slop`.
